grid.title: Relação de Vendas/Pedidos Por Previsão de Entrega
grid.expression: SELECT V.CODPARC, V.RAZAOSOCIAL, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 1 THEN V.VLRNEG ELSE 0 END) AS JANEIRO, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 2 THEN V.VLRNEG ELSE 0 END) AS FEVEREIRO, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 3 THEN V.VLRNEG ELSE 0 END) AS MAR, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 4 THEN V.VLRNEG ELSE 0 END) AS ABRIL, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 5 THEN V.VLRNEG ELSE 0 END) AS MAIO, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 6 THEN V.VLRNEG ELSE 0 END) AS JUNHO, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 7 THEN V.VLRNEG ELSE 0 END) AS JULHO, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 8 THEN V.VLRNEG ELSE 0 END) AS AGOSTO, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 9 THEN V.VLRNEG ELSE 0 END) AS SETEMBRO, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 10 THEN V.VLRNEG ELSE 0 END) AS OUTUBRO, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 11 THEN V.VLRNEG ELSE 0 END) AS NOVEMBRO, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 12 THEN V.VLRNEG ELSE 0 END) AS DEZEMBRO FROM ( SELECT CAB.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, SUM(COALESCE(CAB.VLRNOTA,0) + COALESCE(CAB.VLROUTROS,0)) AS VLRNEG, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAB.DTPREVENT) AS MES, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAB.DTPREVENT) AS ANO FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC WHERE CAB.TIPMOV = 'P' AND CAB.DTPREVENT IS NOT NULL AND CAB.PENDENTE = 'S' AND CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND (CAB.CODEMP = 501 OR CAB.STATUSNFE <> 'D') GROUP BY CAB.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAB.DTPREVENT), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAB.DTPREVENT) ) V WHERE V.ANO = :P_ANO GROUP BY V.CODPARC, V.RAZAOSOCIAL ORDER BY V.CODPARC
